mission: Attack duplicate identity and false-health claims in Capability Genome doctor.

finding.before: The doctor revalidated each record but did not require collection-level unique capability ids or canonical identities. Duplicate canonical records could reduce dedupedCapabilityCount while the same collection still reported FOUNDATION_HEALTHY.
finding.after: The doctor now fails closed on duplicate capability ids and duplicate canonical capability identities before emitting a healthy state or counts.

changes: Bound dedupedCapabilityCount to the already validated canonical identity set.
Added deterministic hostile tests for canonical collision and exact id duplication.

verification.note: Connector permits repository mutation and CI inspection but does not provide an authenticated local checkout/runtime. Source is not claimed green until exact-head CI evidence exists.

nextAttack: unsafe cyclic or transitive dependency trees
